csd:Source/CSDZC##.rdo::FILE(ZC@ID@FILE).why: The brief said a name may hold only 'A-Z, 0-9, @ # $', and the reviewer (flagging it as its own judgement call) skipped CSDZC##.rdo because its names are written in lower case (`ZC@id@`). CSD names are case-insensitive and the key -- like the engine -- applies the character check before upper-casing, so `ZC@id@` is letters and @ only: a valid name, kept as ZC@ID@. It is zECS's install-time template token (substituted per instance), unlike `<DB2SSID>`, whose `<>` no CICS name can hold; keeping it keeps the TRANSACTION -> ZECS001 / ZECS000 links. The brief now says letters of either case. Line, type, group and every attribute of the 13 rows are as the key records them in the source.
